stations.name: Topic selection
checks: Read the latest comment report (reports/comments/) first; rank viewer-question follow-ups with the search picks
Comments = proven demand; run before Mon/Thu topic planning (Joe)
Topic backed by measured search growth (Google Trends, Wikipedia pageviews, TikTok Creator Search Insights)
Topic picks go to Joe first; nothing renders until he chooses
Topic is in the approved week/batch

stations.name: Long vs short
checks: Default VIDEO; carousel only if <6 licensed photos, static list, same-day deadline, or can't fill 61 s
Short must reach ≥63 s without padding
TikTok payout needs >61 s; 2 s margin

stations.name: Wow-factor check
checks: Short: exactly one clear wow; long-form: several
Wow is a curiosity, not a committee 'gap fix' list

stations.name: Hook
checks: Hook hits hard with a dramatic visual reveal in 0–3 s
Style: Real-Photo Hidden Machine (credited PD/CC photo held ~2 s → 3D cutaway) or CAR10 twist hook
Headline on screen from frame 1, no fade-in (CAR10)

stations.name: Script & fact-check
checks: 100% of claims sourced; numbers cross-checked with a second source
Every line maps to a fact ID; US units
CAR10 structure: twist hook → disaster → how it works → this week's numbers → debate question
Ending clearly answers the question it raises (no cliffhanger)
Teasers answer the question on the same platform (no 'full answer on YouTube')
NYC water: top TikTok comment complained, 1,260 likes

stations.name: Shot list & storyboard
checks: No build starts before storyboard APPROVED
No split screens; zoom ≤1.15×; holds ≤3 s; image used ≤2×
boardlint.py PASS on timing.json and shotlist.csv

stations.name: Generation & build
checks: One build round + at most one polish pass; no repeated fix loops
Visuals premium, glassy, photoreal; no flat hand-drawn diagrams
CC credit on the photo only, never in captions
Don't force 24 fps clips to 30 fps or slow-mo by frame repeat

stations.name: Voice & music
checks: -14 LUFS integrated, limiter -1 dBTP; music ducked under VO
Listen to the final VO line wording

stations.name: QC checks
checks: check_smoothness.py: CFR, no dropped/duplicated/frozen frames, A/V sync ≤50 ms, first 5 s strict
holdcheck, pace, padcheck, edgecheck, ocrcheck, provcheck, stt_check, layoutgate green

stations.name: Reviewer
checks: Reviewer PASS ≠ done; Joe's taste is the bar
Reviewer must not replace a search-backed hook

stations.name: Joe sign-off
checks: Joe OKs hook, first half, and full video
Every rejection logged in rejections.md and turned into a check within 24 h

stations.name: Post kit
checks: 9:16 cut, 16:9 X cut, cover, captions + hashtags
Shorts cover uploaded manually in desktop Studio (API ignores it)
No 'AI' label or AI-voice wording on any platform

stations.name: Posting per platform
checks: Nothing posts without Joe's own yes
TikTok: Joe posts from phone (video, then caption message)
Bot posts YT, FB, IG, X at best times
Check live profile for duplicates before any post
Covers on live videos not changed without Joe's OK

stations.name: 24h / 72h measurement
checks: Log views at 24 h and 72 h in metrics-log.csv
Bar: 10k views minimum across platforms; 25k+ is good
X numbers are impressions; don't add to views
